name: Archeologicke lokality na Slovensku (Archaeological sites in Slovakia)
title: Archeologicke lokality na Slovensku (Archaeological sites in Slovakia)
description: Zoznam archeologickych lokalit na Slovensku z dat Wikipedie/Wikidata (Q839954 ∩ Q214). Zahrna prehistoricke, keltske, rimske (limes pri Carnunte, Iza/Kelemantia), velkomoravske (Devin, Bratislavsky hrad, Nitra), stredoveke a novoveke naleziska. Mena v slovencine + anglictine + nemcine + madarcine + polstine + cestine, s vyhladavacimi poliami pre suradnice, administrativnu lokalitu (kraj/okres/obec), cas vzniku, kulturnu vrstvu a Wikipedia odkazy. (List of archaeological sites in Slovakia from Wikipedia/Wikidata (Q839954 ∩ Q214). Includes prehistoric, Celtic, Roman (Carnuntum-adjacent limes, Iza/Kelemantia), Great Moravian (Devin, Bratislava Castle, Nitra), medieval and modern-era sites. Names in Slovak + English + German + Hungarian + Polish + Czech with searchable fields for coordinates, administrative location, inception date, cultural layer and Wikipedia URLs.)

meta.title: Archeologicke lokality na Slovensku (Archaeological sites in Slovakia) - Bezplatné stiahnutie
meta.description: Zoznam archeologickych lokalit na Slovensku z dat Wikipedie/Wikidata (Q839954 ∩ Q214). Zahrna prehistoricke, keltske, rimske (limes pri Carnunte, Iza/Kelemantia), velkomoravske (Devin, Bratislavsky hrad, Nitra), stredoveke a novoveke naleziska. Mena v slovencine + anglictine + nemcine + madarcine + polstine + cestine, s vyhladavacimi poliami pre suradnice, administrativnu lokalitu (kraj/okres/obec), cas vzniku, kulturnu vrstvu a Wikipedia odkazy. (List of archaeological sites in Slovakia from Wikipedia/Wikidata (Q839954 ∩ Q214). Includes prehistoric, Celtic, Roman (Carnuntum-adjacent limes, Iza/Kelemantia), Great Moravian (Devin, Bratislava Castle, Nitra), medieval and modern-era sites. Names in Slovak + English + German + Hungarian + Polish + Czech with searchable fields for coordinates, administrative location, inception date, cultural layer and Wikipedia URLs.) Obsahuje 167 záznamov. Stiahnuť vo formátoch Excel, CSV, PDF.
